def _model(app_name, model_name):
    if not app_name or not model_name:
        raise Http404("Referência de entidade inválida na página avançada.")
    model = apps.get_model(app_name, model_name)
    if model is None:
        raise Http404("Entidade da página avançada não encontrada.")
    return model


def _model_for(page):
    return _model(page.get("context_app_name"), page.get("context_model_name"))


def _rbac_for(app_name):
    if not app_name:
        return None
    try:
        return __import__(f"{app_name}.rbac", fromlist=["has_entity_action"])
    except Exception:
        return None


def _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, action):
    rbac = _rbac_for(app_name)
    if rbac is None:
        return False
    try:
        return bool(rbac.has_entity_action(request.user, entity_name, action))
    except Exception:
        return False


def _require_page_access(request, page):
    entity_name = page.get("context_entity")
    kind = page.get("context_kind")
    if kind == "none":
        return
    if kind not in {"collection", "record"} or not entity_name:
        raise PermissionDenied("Contexto da página avançada inválido.")
    action = "list" if kind == "collection" else "view"
    if not _has_entity_action(request, page.get("context_app_name"), entity_name, action):
        raise PermissionDenied(f"Acesso negado para {entity_name}:{action}.")


def _component_allowed(request, page, component):
    kind = component.get("binding_kind")
    component_type = component.get("type")
    if kind in {"none", "page_context"}:
        return True
    entity_name = component.get("binding_entity")
    app_name = component.get("binding_app_name")
    if kind in {"entity", "crud"}:
        action = "list" if component_type == "table" else "view"
        return bool(entity_name and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, action))
    if kind in {"field", "form", "workflow"}:
        return bool(entity_name and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, "view"))
    return False


def _load_component_data(page, component, *, advanced_record=None, advanced_collection=None):
    kind = component.get("binding_kind")
    if kind == "page_context":
        return advanced_record if page.get("context_kind") == "record" else advanced_collection
    if kind in {"entity", "crud"}:
        return _model(component.get("binding_app_name"), component.get("binding_model_name"))._default_manager.all()
    if kind == "field":
        if advanced_record is None or component.get("binding_entity") != page.get("context_entity"):
            return None
        field_name = component.get("binding_field")
        return getattr(advanced_record, field_name, None) if field_name else None
    return None


@login_required
def advanced_page_view(request, page_id, pk=None):
    page = ADVANCED_PAGES.get(page_id)
    if page is None:
        raise Http404("Página avançada não encontrada.")
    _require_page_access(request, page)
    kind = page["context_kind"]
    context = {"advanced_page": page, "advanced_record": None, "advanced_collection": None}
    if kind == "record":
        if pk is None:
            raise Http404("Registro da página avançada não informado.")
        context["advanced_record"] = get_object_or_404(_model_for(page), pk=pk)
    elif kind == "collection":
        context["advanced_collection"] = _model_for(page)._default_manager.all()
    elif kind != "none":
        raise Http404("Contexto da página avançada inválido.")

    for component in page.get("components", []):
        key = component["runtime_key"]
        visible = _component_allowed(request, page, component)
        context[f"{key}_visible"] = visible
        context[key] = _load_component_data(
            page,
            component,
            advanced_record=context["advanced_record"],
            advanced_collection=context["advanced_collection"],
        ) if visible else None
    return render(request, page["template"], context)
